verdict.rationale: React has no separate template syntax—JSX is embedded directly in TypeScript/TSX files, and docs mention adding @types/react and @types/react-dom for 'full React Web support,' implying type checking applies uniformly across JSX and script code rather than as a distinct template-checking feature. There's no explicit documentation demonstrating dedicated type-checking tooling for JSX expressions analogous to template type-checking in other frameworks. missing for 10: explicit documentation/tooling demonstrating JSX-specific type inference or errors, independent corroboration of JSX type-checking behavior, and any mention of template-vs-script distinction relevant to React's architecture.
